hook: Three shadows at the gate. Bet you can't name all three!
c1: Round one. Comes for the bubbles.
r1: Sir Waddles the corgi, from Lady Pemberton!
c2: Round two. Comes after a paddle at the Splash Pool.
r2: Rapunzel the Afghan Hound, from Madame Dubois!
c3: Round three, the sneaky one. Comes when the leaves turn.
r3: Momiji the Shiba, from Mister Kimura! Not a squirrel.
ask: How many did you get? Tell me below!
